summary: Optional, flag-gated Chatterbox (MIT) expressive engine behind the existing TTSEngine contract. The default speech-core image, requirements.txt and all existing endpoint shapes are unchanged; the adapter module is imported only when CHATTERBOX_ENABLED=true and lazy-loads on first request. This revision removes the phantom tokenizer.json from the turbo required-file set (which made the documented CHATTERBOX_VARIANT=turbo deployment permanently undownloadable and unloadable), pins the upstream repository layout in a checked-in fixture so the same class of drift cannot recur silently, aligns the resident-memory advisory with the measurement page it cites, tightens the requirements test to the exact pins, refreshes the upstream size constants with a capture date, stops reporting phonetic_preprocess=false as an ignored control, strengthens the slow prosody assertion, and rebases the branch onto master with the docs reconciled additively.
